skymanbp-cc-tree-tree.description: Universal radial-tree exploration engine — loads a preset, grounds a root, expands every node through 12 framing passes, derives each child in 12 evidence-bearing fields, scores it, and recurses on `advances` leaves until substantive convergence (or a user cap). Caps default to ∞; `defer / TODO / NEEDS-MORE-INFO` leaves are hard-banned. Use when the user wants the engine itself — a custom preset via `--preset <path>`, explicit control of a run, or "tree of thoughts" / 穷尽的树状探索 in general; for the four shipped use-cases prefer `/cc-tree:brainstorm`, `/cc-tree:attack`, `/cc-tree:design`,…
